sec: Aldosterone and steroid biosynthesis pathway · p839

items.q: StAR stands for ___, the rate-limiting step of steroid synthesis.
items.exp: StAR = steroid acute regulatory protein; it is the rate-limiting step and its defect causes congenital lipid hyperplasia. (Book p839)

items.q: StAR catalyses the first step, converting:
items.exp: Cholesterol (LDL) enters via StAR to form pregnenolone. (Book p839)

items.q: A neonate with pan-steroid deficiency is found to have a StAR defect. The named condition is:
items.exp: The StAR defect (rate-limiting step) causes congenital lipid hyperplasia. (Book p839)

items.q: Match the 17α-hydroxylase conversions — 1) Pregnenolone  2) Progesterone … A) 17OH-progesterone  B) 17OH-pregnenolone

items.exp: 17,20 lyase yields dehydroepiandrosterone from 17OH-pregnenolone (and androstenedione from 17OH-progesterone). (Book p839)
3β-HSD converts pregnenolone→progesterone (and the 17OH pair likewise). (Book p839)

items.q: Match the 21α-hydroxylase substrates/products — 1) Progesterone  2) 17OH-progesterone … A) 11-Deoxycortisol  B) Deoxycorticosterone
Match the 11β-hydroxylase conversions — 1) Deoxycorticosterone  2) 11-Deoxycortisol … A) Cortisol  B) Corticosterone
Match the aldosterone arm — 1) Corticosterone →(18-hydroxylase)  2) 18OH-corticosterone →(aldosterone synthase) … A) Aldosterone  B) 18OH-corticosterone
Which enzymes are present ONLY in the zona glomerulosa?
items.exp: The 18-hydroxylase/aldosterone synthase arm is only in ZG, explaining zone-specific aldosterone. (Book p839)

items.q: Match gonadal enzymes — 1) Androstenedione→testosterone  2) Testosterone→DHT  3) Androstenedione→estrone … A) 5α-reductase type II  B) Aromatase (POR)  C) 17β-HSD type 3
items.exp: 17β-HSD type 3 makes testosterone (and estradiol from estrone); 5α-reductase type II makes DHT (testis); aromatase (POR) makes estrone (ovary). (Book p839)

items.q: In the pathway, POR stands for ___.
items.exp: POR = P450 oxidoreductase; DHT = dihydrotestosterone; StAR = steroid acute regulatory protein. (Book p839)
